verdict.rationale: No evidence anywhere in the pack that Microsoft Authenticator supports Steam Guard tokens, HOTP counters, or custom period/digit-length TOTP configurations; documentation only covers standard push/OTP sign-in for Microsoft and Entra-linked accounts. Community evidence even suggests the opposite direction — MS Authenticator issues non-standard QR codes that other TOTP clients reject, implying limited flexibility rather than expanded token-format support.
